scope: M02 terrain-only original composition studies, not runtime maps

prompts.prompt: Create an original 2048x768 (8:3) crisp pixel-art underwater natural pond game background, M02 OLD ROOT POOL variant A, TERRAIN AND LARGE COMPOSITION ONLY. Cohesive hand-placed pixel clusters, muted dark teal depth, subdued olive-brown wood and silt, stepped pixel edges, not realistic painting. Wide side-view, no text/UI/border. Distinctive dominant form: ONE old submerged tree base enters from the far LEFT edge (x0-20%); its thick weathered bare buttress roots cling to the left bank and curl DOWNWARD into silt, ending before x34%. Root anatomy irregular and natural, no repeated parallel logs, no intertwined mesh across the screen, no tunnel arch. Left bank is rounded eroded mud, not stepped rock. A long low irregular silty slope settles into a broad central pool bottom at y89-94%, offset low point x63%. Far right bank is low with a small subordinate cluster of smooth partly buried stones at x88%, no tall cliff, no standing tree at right. Preserve empty continuous water across x30-80%, y15-72%; nothing crosses central water. Root shade gives left side mysterious darkness; ONE broad soft diagonal shaft from upper right reveals the open pool and silt. Faint distant stump silhouette at far right lower edge only, strong atmospheric recession, no repeating rows of tree trunks. Foreground limited to small dark lowest corner fragments. Gentle eroded slopes with unequal lengths, no sinusoidal humps, no symmetrical U. ONLY bare dead woody roots, terrain, stones, water, light. NO grass, moss, algae, foliage, living hanging rootlets, lily pads, plants, fish, shrimp, snails or animals; ecology is a later stage. No gameplay objects. This should feel like a quiet shaded bank of a natural pond, not a mangrove jungle or cavern, and look structurally distinct from a stone shelf bay or a bridge-log valley.

Original 2048x768 panorama, 8:3, crisp deliberately clustered pixel art for a side-view underwater pond game. M02 OLD ROOT POOL variant B, first-round TERRAIN AND LARGE FORMS ONLY. Create a sheltered erosion cove with one tipped dead ROOT PLATE and short broken trunk anchored on the lower RIGHT bank x77-100%, y48-94%; the radial root disk leans away from central water toward the right edge. Roots are thick gnarled bare dead wood, weathered brown, visibly attached to one root plate, with short irregular tips buried in mud, not a living plant. This is an uprooted root plate resting low, NOT a giant upright tree trunk from the top of the screen and NOT a mirrored left-tree composition. A low eroded mud shelf at left x0-23%, y71-90% has one small water-scoured stone half embedded. A broad gently sloping sediment basin lies between banks, its shallow asymmetric runoff groove curls along bottom x30-70%, lowest y93%. Keep a huge continuous central water opening x24-75%, y12-72%. A narrow diffuse overhead opening at upper center-left sends two subtle soft underwater shafts diagonally toward left-bottom sediment; right root plate is mostly in cool shade with a few muted highlights. Deep dark teal water, dull olive-brown silt and wood, cool low-contrast distant banks. Only an extremely faint far lower-left drowned root silhouette provides depth, no forest of trunks, no log bridge or mesh of crossed branches. Small foreground mud fragments only in bottom corners, not a thick full-width band. Avoid perfectly symmetric U valleys, sinusoidal terrain, rows of repeated humps, artificial rectangular steps or noisy photographic material. Pixel edges clearly stepped, medium-sized purposeful clusters, no painterly blur. NO leaves, moss, algae, grass, vines, living rootlets, floating foliage, fish, shrimp, snails, other animals, characters, hooks, food, UI, captions or borders. These will be later stages. Only geology, dead root wood, water and light. Quiet natural shaded pond, not a cave, jungle, mangrove swamp or fantasy monster.
